Dattatreya S Vellal
Email: dsvellal@gmail.com | Mobile: +91-99723-12693
Updated resume: http://goo.gl/lCuLWI

=== SUMMARY / ROLES ===

April 2013 – Present (Senior Technical Lead – Exeter Software India Pvt. Ltd.): Responsible for design and implementation of features and handling end-end deliverables and product releases for OneGate project. OneGate is an implementation of Affordable Care Act (ACA / Obama Care).

March 2011 – March 2013 (Staff Software Engineer – IBM): Developer for Natural Resources Center of Excellence. Wrote middleware services in Java for the condition monitoring solution at Industry Solutions, India Software Labs, IBM India Pvt. Ltd.

December 2010 – March 2011 (Software Engineer – IBM): Lead and Worldwide contact for Lotus Expeditor Webcontainer.

October 2008 – December 2010 (Associate Software Engineer – IBM): Developer and component owner for Lotus Expeditor Toolkit. Successful delivery of v6.2.1, v6.2.2, v6.2.3 leading activities.

July 2007 – September 2008 (Associate Software Engineer – IBM): Developer for JAX-WS layer enablement on Lotus Expeditor and Light Weight Infrastructure.

=== SKILLS ===
Languages: Java
Web: J2EE, Web Services, SOAP, XML
Databases: DB2
IDEs: STS, Eclipse, RAD, RSA, WID, IID
Servers: Lotus Expeditor & Toolkit, WPS, WAS, Weblogic
Products: Lotus Notes, Lotus Sametime, IBM Smart Cloud for Social Business
Other tools: SOAPUI

=== PROJECTS ===

OneGate – An ACA Implementation (April 2013 – Present)
Details: Implementation of the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (PPACA/ACA) — comprehensive health insurance reforms. Youngest member of the Architecture and Prototyping group; only member from India representing the entire OneGate India team in the architecture group.
Key contributions:
- Designed and implemented complex features for OneGate's Health Insurance Exchange (HIX) system, involving architectural changes across technology layers
- Responsible for architecture and design of Integrated Eligibility System (IES) of OneGate
- Evangelized process changes to defect management, configuration management, commit management
- Provided quick resolutions during customer crit-sits
- Managed end-end releases from scoping to successful delivery
- Introduced processes to achieve delivery excellence (Dev-QA communication, reduced reopens via unit and functional testing)
- Provided quarterly and yearly performance feedback
- Conducted candidate interviews and helped absorbing the right talent
- Mentored members and helped them grow into senior developer roles
- Youngest member of the Architecture and Prototyping group; only India member in the architecture group

Natural Resource Center of Excellence – Advanced Condition Monitoring for High Value Assets (March 2011 – March 2013)

JAXWS Layer for LWI 8.1.x (July 2007 – September 2008)
